title: The bank is down
story: The pretend bank stops answering for a minute. The Guard's circuit breaker trips, so a payment is refused at once with a time to retry instead of hanging. Decisions keep working throughout, because they never depend on the bank.

steps.label: Take the bank down for 60 seconds

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: I'm ready to shop when you are.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The Decision worked during the outage, and the payment was refused at once with nothing written, so ShopBot can safely retry. Every visitor sees the banner while the outage runs, and another can't start for 5 minutes.
